examples.en: The portrait shows a young woman with a smooth, clear complexion.
examples.zh: 這幅肖像畫中的年輕女子有著光滑、乾淨無瑕的臉部皮膚。

examples.en: Lack of sleep gave him a pale complexion.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足讓他臉色蒼白。

examples.en: The new evidence changed the whole complexion of the case.
examples.zh: 新的證據改變了整個案件的面貌。

examples.en: The school offers a comprehensive reading program.
examples.zh: 這所學校提供全面的閱讀課程。

examples.en: We bought comprehensive insurance for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們為這趟旅行買了全險。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a comprehensive list of study tips.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一份詳盡的讀書技巧清單。

examples.en: The library plans to computerize its records this year.
examples.zh: 圖書館打算今年把館藏紀錄電腦化。

examples.en: Many banks have computerized their services to reduce long waiting times.
examples.zh: 許多銀行已將服務電腦化，以縮短冗長的等候時間。

examples.en: It took months to computerize the hospital's files.
examples.zh: 醫院的檔案花了好幾個月才完成電腦化。

examples.en: He thanked his comrades for their help.
examples.zh: 他感謝夥伴們的幫忙。

examples.en: The old soldier met his comrade after many years.
examples.zh: 那位老兵事隔多年與他的戰友重逢。

examples.en: The workers called each other comrade at the meeting.
examples.zh: 工人們在會議上彼此稱呼同志。

examples.en: Both sides made a concession to end the dispute.
examples.zh: 雙方各自讓步，以結束爭議。

examples.en: Students can get a concession on train tickets.
examples.zh: 學生購買火車票可享有優惠。

examples.en: The company won a concession to run the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 這家公司取得了經營餐廳的特許權。

examples.en: Please write a concise summary of the article.
examples.zh: 請為這篇文章寫一份簡明的摘要。

examples.en: His answer was concise and easy for the interviewer to understand.
examples.zh: 他的回答很簡潔，面試官很容易理解。

examples.en: The guide gives concise directions to the station.
examples.zh: 這份指南提供了前往車站的簡明路線。

examples.en: Heat the milk gently to condense it before making the dessert.
examples.zh: 製作甜點前，輕輕加熱牛奶，使它濃縮。

examples.en: Can you condense your report into one page?
examples.zh: 你能把報告濃縮成一頁嗎？

examples.en: Water vapor condenses on the cold window.
examples.zh: 水蒸氣在冰冷的窗戶上凝結。

examples.en: The nations formed a confederation to protect trade.
examples.zh: 這些國家組成聯盟來保護貿易。

examples.en: Our teacher explained how a confederation differs from a single country.
examples.zh: 老師解釋了邦聯與單一國家有何不同。

examples.en: The sports confederation will meet in Tokyo next month.
examples.zh: 這個體育聯盟下個月將在東京開會。

examples.en: The congresswoman visited our school last week.
examples.zh: 那位女國會議員上週來我們學校參訪。

examples.en: She is a respected congresswoman in her state.
examples.zh: 她是州內備受敬重的女國會議員。

examples.en: Students wrote letters to the congresswoman about the new park.
examples.zh: 學生們寫信給那位女議員，談論新公園的事。

examples.en: The conquest of the island took several years.
examples.zh: 征服這座島花了好幾年。

examples.en: The book describes the conquest of ancient Egypt.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了古埃及被征服的經過。

examples.en: He boasted about his latest conquest in the chess club.
examples.zh: 他在西洋棋社吹噓自己最新的勝利。

examples.en: She is a conscientious student who never misses homework.
examples.zh: 她是個認真負責的學生，從不漏交作業。

examples.en: Our conscientious driver checked the bus before every trip.
examples.zh: 我們細心的司機每次出發前都會檢查巴士。

examples.en: A conscientious worker always double-checks the numbers.
examples.zh: 認真負責的員工總會再次核對數字。

examples.en: We should conserve water during the dry season.
examples.zh: 乾季期間我們應該節約用水。

examples.en: The group works to conserve the local forest.
examples.zh: 這個團體致力於保護當地森林。

examples.en: Turn off the lights to conserve energy.
examples.zh: 關燈以節約能源。

examples.en: Her kind words were a great consolation to me.
examples.zh: 她親切的話語對我是很大的安慰。

examples.en: The team lost, but won a consolation prize.
examples.zh: 球隊輸了比賽，卻拿到了安慰獎。

examples.en: It was little consolation that the rain stopped later.
examples.zh: 雨後來停了，也沒帶來多少安慰。

examples.en: She tried to console her crying little brother.
examples.zh: 她試著安慰哭泣的弟弟。

examples.en: Friends came to console him after the bad news.
examples.zh: 聽到壞消息後，朋友們前來安慰他。

examples.en: Nothing could console the team after the loss.
examples.zh: 輸球之後，什麼都無法安慰這支球隊。

examples.en: He bought a new game console for his birthday.
examples.zh: 他買了一台新的遊戲主機當生日禮物。

examples.en: The pilot checked the control console before starting the engine.
examples.zh: 飛行員在啟動引擎前檢查了控制台。

examples.en: The console sits next to the television in the living room.
examples.zh: 主機放在客廳電視旁邊。

examples.en: Police uncovered a conspiracy to rob the bank.
examples.zh: 警方揭發了一起搶銀行的陰謀。

examples.en: Some people suspect a conspiracy behind every major news story.
examples.zh: 有些人懷疑每則重大新聞背後都有陰謀。

examples.en: The movie is about a conspiracy inside a large company.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一家大公司內部的陰謀。

examples.en: There is much contention over the new school rules.
examples.zh: 新校規引發了許多爭論。

examples.en: It is my contention that homework should be shorter.
examples.zh: 我的論點是功課應該要少一點。

examples.en: The two teams are in contention for the title.
examples.zh: 這兩支隊伍正在爭奪冠軍。

examples.en: Each contestant has three minutes to speak.
examples.zh: 每位參賽者有三分鐘的發言時間。

examples.en: The young contestant won the singing contest.
examples.zh: 那位年輕的參賽者贏得了歌唱比賽。

examples.en: Ten contestants entered the cooking show, hoping to win a cash prize.
examples.zh: 十位參賽者參加了這個烹飪節目，希望贏得獎金。

examples.en: The teacher worked to keep continuity between lessons.
examples.zh: 老師努力讓各堂課之間保持連貫。

examples.en: A good story needs continuity from start to finish.
examples.zh: 好故事需要從頭到尾保持連貫。

examples.en: The new manager wanted to ensure continuity in service.
examples.zh: 新經理想確保服務不中斷。

examples.en: Please don't contradict your teacher in class.
examples.zh: 請不要在課堂上反駁老師。

examples.en: His actions contradict what he said yesterday.
examples.zh: 他的行為與他昨天說的話相互矛盾。

examples.en: The two reports contradict each other about when the accident happened.
examples.zh: 這兩份報告對於事故發生的時間彼此矛盾。

examples.en: The principal will convene a meeting on Friday.
examples.zh: 校長將在週五召開會議。

examples.en: Parents convened in the hall to discuss the trip.
examples.zh: 家長們聚集在大廳討論旅行的事。

examples.en: The committee convenes every month to review the school budget.
examples.zh: 委員會每個月開會，審查學校預算。

examples.en: Colorful fish swim around the coral in the shallow tropical water.
examples.zh: 色彩繽紛的魚在熱帶淺水區的珊瑚周圍游動。

examples.en: Warm seas help coral grow, but excessive heat can damage it.
examples.zh: 溫暖的海水有助於珊瑚生長，但過高的水溫可能傷害珊瑚。

examples.en: She wore a necklace made of pink coral.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條粉紅色珊瑚做的項鍊。

examples.en: Detectives examined the corpse for clues before writing their report.
examples.zh: 偵探在撰寫報告前檢查屍體，尋找線索。

examples.en: The museum displays an ancient corpse found in the desert.
examples.zh: 博物館展示著在沙漠中發現的一具古代屍體。

examples.en: Doctors tried to identify the corpse using the available dental records.
examples.zh: 醫師試著利用現有的牙科紀錄辨識屍體身分。

examples.en: She keeps all her correspondence in a small box.
examples.zh: 她把所有的信件都收在一個小盒子裡。

examples.en: Our correspondence lasted for many years after we moved to different cities.
examples.zh: 我們搬到不同城市後，書信往來持續了多年。

examples.en: There is little correspondence between the two stories.
examples.zh: 這兩個故事幾乎沒有相符之處。

examples.en: She has a cosmetic bag full of brushes.
examples.zh: 她有一個裝滿刷具的化妝包。

examples.en: The repairs were only cosmetic and did not fix the leak.
examples.zh: 這些修繕只是表面功夫，並沒有修好漏水的問題。

examples.en: The factory sells cosmetic products to many countries.
examples.zh: 這家工廠把美容產品賣到許多國家。

examples.en: Her favorite cosmetic is a soft pink lipstick.
examples.zh: 她最愛的化妝品是柔和的粉紅色口紅。

examples.en: Every cosmetic on the shelf is on sale.
examples.zh: 架上的每一件化妝品都在特價。

examples.en: This cosmetic is made with natural oils.
examples.zh: 這件化妝品是用天然油製成的。

examples.en: She buys her cosmetics at the department store.
examples.zh: 她在百貨公司買化妝品。

examples.en: Cosmetics should be kept away from direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 化妝品應避免陽光直射。

examples.en: The store sells cosmetics from many countries.
examples.zh: 這家店販售來自許多國家的化妝品。

examples.en: The mayor met his counterpart from Japan.
examples.zh: 市長與日本的同級官員會面。

examples.en: The new model is faster than its counterpart.
examples.zh: 新型號比與它相對應的機種更快。

examples.en: She emailed her counterpart at the other branch.
examples.zh: 她寫電子郵件給另一間分公司的同職位同事。

examples.en: I have a coupon for a free drink.
examples.zh: 我有一張免費飲料的優待券。

examples.en: Use this coupon to save ten percent.
examples.zh: 使用這張折價券可省下一成。

examples.en: The coupon expires at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 這張優待券在月底到期。

examples.en: Students eat lunch in the school courtyard.
examples.zh: 學生們在學校中庭吃午餐。

examples.en: An old tree stands in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 庭院裡有一棵老樹。

examples.en: The hotel has a quiet courtyard with a fountain.
examples.zh: 這間旅館有個安靜的庭院，裡面有座噴泉。

examples.en: It was cowardly to blame others for his mistake.
examples.zh: 把自己的錯怪到別人頭上很懦弱。

examples.en: The cowardly dog hid under the bed.
examples.zh: 那隻膽小的狗躲到了床底下。

examples.en: She felt cowardly for not speaking up.
examples.zh: 她因為沒有站出來發言而覺得自己很懦弱。

examples.en: We spent a cozy evening by the fireplace.
examples.zh: 我們在壁爐旁度過了溫馨的夜晚。

examples.en: The café has a cozy atmosphere, with soft lighting and comfortable chairs.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳氣氛溫馨舒適，燈光柔和，椅子也很舒服。

examples.en: She wore a cozy sweater on the cold morning.
examples.zh: 寒冷的早晨，她穿了一件暖和舒適的毛衣。

examples.en: Police announced a crackdown on illegal parking.
examples.zh: 警方宣布嚴厲取締違規停車。

examples.en: The school began a crackdown on cheating.
examples.zh: 學校開始嚴格整頓作弊的情形。

examples.en: A crackdown on fake goods is planned for next week.
examples.zh: 下週預計嚴厲查緝仿冒品。

examples.en: She ate a cracker with some cheese.
examples.zh: 她配著起司吃了一片薄脆餅乾。

examples.en: The soup comes with two crackers and a small bread roll.
examples.zh: 這份湯附有兩片薄脆餅乾和一個小餐包。

examples.en: Someone set off a loud cracker near the temple.
examples.zh: 有人在廟旁點燃了一枚很響的鞭炮。

examples.en: I got a cramp in my leg while swimming.
examples.zh: 我游泳時腿抽筋了。

examples.en: A stomach cramp kept her home from school.
examples.zh: 胃痙攣讓她沒去上學。

examples.en: Stretching can help prevent a muscle cramp.
examples.zh: 伸展可以幫助預防肌肉抽筋。

examples.en: Wearing tight shoes can cramp your feet.
examples.zh: 穿太緊的鞋可能讓你的腳抽筋。

examples.en: Small rooms cramp the children's play, especially when they try to run.
examples.zh: 狹小的房間限制了孩子們的玩耍活動，尤其是他們想奔跑時。

examples.en: Sitting still too long may cramp your legs.
examples.zh: 坐太久不動可能會讓你的腿抽筋。

examples.en: We hiked up to the crater of the volcano.
examples.zh: 我們健行到火山口。

examples.en: A huge crater was left by the meteor.
examples.zh: 隕石留下了一個巨大的坑洞。

examples.en: The moon is covered with craters formed by impacts from space rocks.
examples.zh: 月球表面布滿了太空岩石撞擊所形成的隕石坑。

examples.en: The witness gave a credible account of the accident.
examples.zh: 目擊者對這起意外提出了可信的說法。

examples.en: Is there a credible source for this news?
examples.zh: 這則新聞有可靠的消息來源嗎？

examples.en: She is a credible candidate for the job.
examples.zh: 她是這份工作值得信賴的人選。

examples.en: The crocodile lay still beside the river.
examples.zh: 那隻鱷魚靜靜地躺在河邊。

examples.en: We saw a baby crocodile at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻小鱷魚。

examples.en: A crocodile has a very strong jaw.
examples.zh: 鱷魚有非常強壯的下顎。

examples.en: Wait for the green light at the crossing.
examples.zh: 在路口等綠燈亮再走。

examples.en: There is a railway crossing near our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校附近有一個平交道。

examples.en: The ferry crossing takes about an hour.
examples.zh: 這趟渡輪航程大約要一個小時。

examples.en: The cumulative effect of stress can harm your health.
examples.zh: 壓力累積的影響可能會損害健康。

examples.en: Our cumulative score is the highest in the class.
examples.zh: 我們的累計分數是全班最高的。

examples.en: The test measures cumulative learning over the year.
examples.zh: 這項測驗評量一整年累積的學習成果。

examples.en: Please do not park next to the curb.
examples.zh: 請不要把車停在路緣旁。

examples.en: The government put a curb on rising prices.
examples.zh: 政府對物價上漲採取了抑制措施。

examples.en: He tripped over the curb on the way to school.
examples.zh: 他在上學途中被路緣絆倒。

examples.en: We need to curb our spending this month.
examples.zh: 我們這個月需要控制開銷。

examples.en: The new rule will curb noise at night.
examples.zh: 新規定將抑制夜間的噪音。

examples.en: She tried to curb her anger in front of the class.
examples.zh: 她試著在全班面前克制怒氣。

examples.en: My parents set a curfew of ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 爸媽規定我的門禁是十點。

examples.en: The city announced a curfew after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，市政府宣布實施宵禁。

examples.en: Dorm students must follow the curfew and return before eleven.
examples.zh: 住宿學生必須遵守門禁，在十一點前返回宿舍。

examples.en: We had chicken curry with rice for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了咖哩雞飯。

examples.en: This curry is a little too spicy for me.
examples.zh: 這道咖哩對我來說有點太辣。

examples.en: My mother makes curry on rainy days.
examples.zh: 媽媽在下雨天會煮咖哩。

examples.en: It is customary to bring a gift when visiting a friend.
examples.zh: 拜訪朋友時，帶份禮物是慣例。

examples.en: He took his customary seat by the window.
examples.zh: 他坐上自己慣常坐的靠窗座位。

examples.en: A tip is customary at most restaurants here.
examples.zh: 這裡大多數餐廳習慣要給小費。

senses.zh: 懷疑他人動機的；冷嘲熱諷的

examples.en: He is cynical about politicians and rarely believes their campaign promises.
examples.zh: 他對政客抱持懷疑態度，很少相信他們的競選承諾。

examples.en: Her cynical remarks upset the whole team.
examples.zh: 她挖苦的言論讓全隊都不高興。

examples.en: Don't be so cynical about this new idea.
examples.zh: 別對這個新想法這麼冷嘲熱諷。

examples.en: The bright sun can dazzle drivers on the road.
examples.zh: 耀眼的陽光會讓路上的駕駛眼花。

examples.en: The magician hoped to dazzle the audience.
examples.zh: 魔術師希望讓觀眾驚嘆不已。

examples.en: Her beautiful voice dazzled everyone at the concert.
examples.zh: 她美妙的歌聲讓音樂會上的每個人都驚豔不已。

examples.en: The loud music will deafen you if you stand too close.
examples.zh: 如果站得太近，大聲的音樂會震得你耳朵發聾。

examples.en: The noise from the train deafened us for a moment.
examples.zh: 火車的噪音讓我們一時之間什麼都聽不見。

examples.en: Loud engines can deafen people over time.
examples.zh: 引擎的巨響久了可能使人失聰。

examples.en: She scored the decisive goal in the final minute.
examples.zh: 她在最後一分鐘踢進了決定性的一球。

examples.en: A good leader must be decisive when unexpected problems arise.
examples.zh: 好的領導者遇到突發問題時，必須果斷。

examples.en: The vote was a decisive victory for our class.
examples.zh: 這次投票是我們班的決定性勝利。

examples.en: Her dedication to teaching inspired many students.
examples.zh: 她對教學的奉獻啟發了許多學生。

examples.en: It takes dedication to practice every day.
examples.zh: 每天練習需要全心投入。

examples.en: The author wrote a short dedication to his parents.
examples.zh: 作者寫了一段簡短的題獻給他的父母。

examples.en: The store will deduct ten dollars from the price.
examples.zh: 商店會從價格中扣除十元。

examples.en: Teachers may deduct points from your grade for late work.
examples.zh: 老師可能會因為遲交作業而扣你的分數。

examples.en: You can deduct this cost from your taxes.
examples.zh: 你可以從稅金中扣除這筆費用。

examples.en: The judge deemed the evidence unreliable after examining the original documents.
examples.zh: 法官檢視原始文件後，認為這項證據不可靠。

examples.en: They deemed it wise to leave early.
examples.zh: 他們認為提早離開比較明智。

examples.en: The school deems honesty very important in both exams and daily life.
examples.zh: 學校認為，無論考試或日常生活，誠實都非常重要。

examples.en: The default language of this app is English.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式的預設語言是英文。

examples.en: The company was in default on its loan.
examples.zh: 這家公司的貸款違約了。

examples.en: Click reset to return to the default settings.
examples.zh: 點選重設即可回到預設設定。

examples.en: He defaulted on his car payments after losing his job.
examples.zh: 他失業後，未能按期繳付汽車分期款。

examples.en: The program will default to English when it starts for the first time.
examples.zh: 程式第一次啟動時，會預設為英文。

examples.en: If you don't choose, it will default to the first option.
examples.zh: 如果你不選擇，它會預設選第一個選項。
